questions.q: The policies, actions, and strategies set up by the government to encourage the selling of agricultural produce to foreign countries is known as ________.
questions.explain: Export promotion involves government incentives, support, and policies aimed at boosting the volume and value of agricultural goods sold internationally.

questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following crops is a major agricultural export produce of Nigeria, highly valued globally for chocolate production?
questions.explain: Cocoa is one of Nigeria's foremost export cash crops, heavily exported to foreign markets primarily for the manufacturing of chocolate and cocoa beverages.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following animal by-products is a major export item for Nigeria's agricultural sector?
questions.explain: Hides and skins (derived from cattle, sheep, and goats) are highly processed in northern Nigeria and exported globally for the leather manufacturing industry.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness

questions.q: A primary national economic benefit of promoting the export of agricultural products like palm produce and groundnut is that it ________.
options: Reduces the number of schools in the country
Attracts foreign exchange into the country
Reduces the value of the local currency permanently
questions.explain: When a country sells goods abroad (exports), it earns payments in foreign currencies (foreign exchange), which boosts the national economy and strengthens the local currency.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: How does export promotion directly benefit the local farmers who produce export crops like cassava and pepper?
options: It completely stops them from paying local taxes
It seizes their land for government use
It serves as an additional market outlet, increasing their income
It forces them to only eat what they grow
questions.explain: Export promotion opens up international markets for farmers. By selling their excess produce abroad, farmers access a larger customer base, thereby earning much higher income.
